home.intro: Timing Sports is an all-in-one sports venue bringing together pickleball, badminton and golf simulation. We give players of every age and level a comfortable, professional place to play. Whether you're picking up a paddle for the first time, sharpening your game, meeting friends for a match, or competing in tournaments and social events, you'll find your kind of fun here.
home.slogan: More sport · More friends · A better life
home.coachText: Private, semi-private and group lessons with coaches who have won at the national and provincial level.
